'''Kirraa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] slave who worked at the Shipyards of [[Gwori]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Kirraa was one of the slaves used as insurance by overseer [[Juhm]] at the Shipyards of Gwori, and helped convince the shipyard foreman [[Mirax (Gwori)|Mirax]] that he made the wrong decision in giving up [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to Juhm. She was also overseer Juhm's personal slave to a begrudging extent. Before the bombing of the Shipyard, she stole back her Jedi saviors' [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and was granted citizenship to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] along with the other slaves.

==Behind the scenes==
Kirraa is one of only two slaves to be given a name in the book. It appears in the book that she and Obi-Wan Kenobi have a relationship, as he is the one to name her and at the end Kenobi is seen waving to her.
